# Data source record

- **Resource ID / record date / status:**
- **Publisher and resource title:**
- **Stable publisher URL, DOI or accession:**
- **Exact version, release, taxon or layer identifier:**
- **Retrieval date and method:**
- **Query, bounding region and filters:**
- **Geographic / temporal / depth coverage:**
- **Format and repository-relative payload location:**
- **Checksum algorithm and value:**
- **Licence / terms reference and sharing conditions:**
- **Required attribution / citation:**
- **Relevant permission or sensitivity handling:**
- **Known quality or access limitations:**
- **Processing artefacts and derived dataset versions:**

For environmental layers, record units, coordinate system, grid resolution, depth stratum, temporal statistic/period and no-data values. For occurrence resources, record taxonomic identifiers, coordinate conventions and observation-date coverage.

Record actual retrieval details. A candidate source is not an acquired resource. Do not include tokens, credentials or sensitive coordinates in a public manifest.
